name: Paperback
summary: A deck-building word game where novelists form words from letter cards to buy better letters and fame cards to win.
rules_text: Each player starts with a small deck of common letters and wild fame cards. Each turn draw 5 cards. Form a valid word using any of your hand cards plus optionally the current common card; fame cards are wild. Count letters for length: if you meet the length track you claim the common card for bonus points and reveal the next one. Resolve abilities of letters used. Score the word by summing the top-left values plus bonuses. Use that score as currency to buy cards from the central offer: two visible cards per price pile plus fame piles. Cost is bottom-left number. Bought cards go to discard. Discard hand and word cards, then draw 5. When draw pile empties, shuffle discard into draw. Game ends when two fame piles are empty or the last common card is taken, then most fame in entire deck wins.
rating_reason: Deck-building word game, hidden hands, no spatial board.
